name: smart-hub
//: Ambiente de dev na nuvem (GitHub Codespaces) — pra trabalhar do tablet com o notebook desligado. NAO builda o .exe (isso exige Windows); tudo o resto (codigo, functions, PWA, git) roda aqui.
postCreateCommand: ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD=1 npm ci && (cd functions && (npm ci || npm install)) && npm i -g firebase-tools && (npm i -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code || true)
